g.text: In FM synthesis , a modulator oscillator varies the frequency of a
carrier oscillator many times per second. The resulting spectrum is
rich with sidebands — frequency components above and below the
carrier — whose number and amplitude are controlled by the
modulation index . The carrier:modulator frequency ratio determines
the spectral character. Integer ratios (1:1, 1:2, 1:3) produce
harmonic timbres — bell-like, piano-like, organ-like. Non-integer
ratios produce inharmonic spectra: metallic cl
